During the [[Great Galactic War]], at some point prior to [[3664 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xerender]] engaged the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] in a '''duel'''. Xerender was joined in his fight by his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wyellett]], who attempted to sway Baras to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]]. The Jedi failed in this task, and although Baras escaped, Wyellett managed to steal the [[Darth Baras' first lightsaber|Sith Lord's lightsaber]] and use it in conjunction with his own.
